sentence: This project studies how peanut sublingual immunotherapy changes mucosal and systemic immune responses, using clinical trial samples and mouse models.
This project tries to make chickens with gene changes that resist avian influenza and other avian viruses.
This project offers screening of small molecules to help researchers create chemical probes that test therapeutic concepts.
This project tests treatment approaches for type I ovarian cancer that target weak DNA repair in tumors with a certain gene mutation.
This project studies how an enzyme that acidifies organelles also takes part in cellular signaling.
This project builds a home self-testing kit that detects HIV RNA using a CRISPR system and an automated microfluidic device.
This project studies how hypoxia changes cells in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma tumors and helps them adapt.
This project studies how age and stroke-related movement and thinking problems affect haptic communication between players of robot-based rehabilitation games.
This project builds a method to estimate how much of autism-related outcomes is explained by genetics and brain imaging.
This project studies how pain phenotypes relate to structural damage in knee osteoarthritis.
This project tracks weight gain and cardiometabolic health in low-income Mexican American children and tries to find out why unhealthy weight gain develops.
This project builds an imaging method that uses Raman-active nanoparticles to read the immune profile of a patient's tissue in a single image.
This project builds and tests an image processing technique for reconstructing images in CT urography examinations of the kidneys.
This project studies how problems in the reward system interfere with supportive relationships and reaching out for help during suicide crises.
This project studies how primate brains produce appropriate social behavior, using neural recordings in freely-moving monkeys interacting with each other.
This project makes and studies patient-derived organoids from normal and colorectal cancer tissue to test possible treatments.
This project tries to find out how nerve terminals in the brain control the release of neurotransmitters in response to calcium signals.
This project looks for mutations in the protein coding region of the human genome that raise the risk of autoimmune disease.
This project tries to find out how exercise-induced gut microbiota metabolites strengthen antitumor immunity in preclinical melanoma models.
This project studies how prostaglandin receptors in kidney epithelial cells affect blood pressure and hypertension.
